title: Veterans Pension Payment Calendar and Account Terms
content:
# Veterans Pension payment calendar and account terms

All six Veterans Pension rate categories share the payment terms below.

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Day of the following month on which a monthly payment is issued | the 1st (the prior business day when the 1st falls on a weekend or holiday) |
| Months after the effective-date month before the first entitlement month is paid | 1 month |
| Minimum lead time for a direct deposit account change to apply to a payment | 10 calendar days before the payment date |
| Returned payments that require suspension | 2 |
| Rolling window for counting returned payments | 12 months |
| Payment for the month of the veteran's death released to the surviving spouse | Yes |

## Worked calendar (hypothetical dates)

- The entitlement month of June is paid on July 1; if July 1 were a Sunday, payment would issue on the preceding Friday, the last business day before it.
- An award effective March 15 has April as its first paid entitlement month, one month after the effective-date month, and that month is paid on May 1.
- An account change recorded 10 calendar days before a payment date applies to that payment; one recorded 9 days before does not.
- A second returned payment inside the 12-month window reaches the count of 2; a single returned payment in that window does not.
